name: viasocket
description: Analyze an input image and generate a concise, factual caption describing its visible contents, including main subjects, objects, actions, and scene. Use this skill when an image needs to be described objectively without speculation or invented details.

name: greeting
description: Outputs a simple greeting message. Use when a basic greeting or acknowledgement is requested.

name: medical-multi-schema-extraction
description: Classifies a medical document as referral, medical_record_request, or progress_note_office_visit, selects the matching schema, then extracts structured data with grounding and confidence.

name: grounded-document-extraction
description: Extract structured data from a document with grounding via vlmrun.document.extract.

name: healthcare-hipaa-release
description: Extracts HIPAA release / authorization details: patient identity, the authorized receiver of the PHI, the disclosing party, scope of records, purpose, signatures, and effective/expiration dates.
